verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فِي ضِيْقِي صَرَخْتُ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لِي.
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، نَجِّ نَفْسِي مِنْ شِفَاهِ ٱلْكَذِبِ، مِنْ لِسَانِ غِشٍّ.
verses.kjv: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, [and] from a deceitful tongue.
verses.web: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

verses.ar: مَاذَا يُعْطِيكَ وَمَاذَا يَزِيدُ لَكَ لِسَانُ ٱلْغِشِّ؟
verses.kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.web: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

verses.ar: سِهَامَ جَبَّارٍ مَسْنُونَةً مَعَ جَمْرِ ٱلرَّتَمِ.
verses.kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.web: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.ar: وَيْلِي لِغُرْبَتِي فِي مَاشِكَ، لِسَكَنِي فِي خِيَامِ قِيدَارَ!
verses.kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, [that] I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.web: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

verses.ar: طَالَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سَكَنُهَا مَعَ مُبْغِضِ ٱلسَّلَامِ.
verses.kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.web: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

verses.ar: أَنَا سَلَامٌ، وَحِينَمَا أَتَكَلَّمُ فَهُمْ لِلْحَرْبِ.
verses.kjv: I [am for] peace: but when I speak, they [are] for war.
verses.web: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
